levels.surface: إسحاق بن عبد، الله بن أبي طلحة

notes: «فيما قرئ عليه عن» is a transmission form; the name after «عن» is the link
«مولى عقيل بن أبي طالب» is the patron of أبا مرة and is left out of the surface

fixes.reason: the word رسول before الله is missing, so the saying's opening reads as one broken word
